name: Client Review Room

guide.title: Precise revision feedback and delivery walkthrough

description: Compare image and video versions, leave precise feedback, and export your review.
features: Real local image/video selection and complete SHA-256 file identities
Normalized image markers and actual video-player timestamps
Per-version categorized open/resolved comments and blocking changes
Explicit ready, changes-requested, approved and delivered transitions
Strict JSON save/restore and fingerprint-based media reconnection
Standalone HTML review report and formula-safe open-work CSV
Three original editorial two-version media packages generated locally
Optional real-account metadata-only workspace sync and viewer/editor invitations
businessHypothesis: A freelancer can use the local review and export workflow before inviting anyone. Repeated deliveries may create return use, while actual review reports or account-authorized invitations can introduce collaborators. Longer cloud history, larger metadata quotas and more collaborators can be tested as paid value; basic local review, data ownership and exports do not require a subscription. No audience or revenue outcome has been established.
